rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an exact copy or reproduction.

example.english: This replica is exactly the same as the original.
example.traditional: 呢件複製品同原作一模一樣。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 fuk1 zai3 ban2 tung4 jyun4 zok3 jat1 mou4 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this for a smaller-scale model of the original, such as a model car or building.

example.english: I bought a replica model of a sports car to put on my desk.
example.traditional: 我買咗架跑車模型擺喺書枱上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gaa3 paau2 ce1 mou4 jing4 baai2 hai2 syu1 ci4 soeng6
